# Python-CLI buildout rules (plugin) — run ONCE during repo creation, then
# discarded. Carries the one-time packaging check.
version: 1.1

rules:
  - name: console_entry_point
    description: |
      true when the CLI is declared as a `project.scripts` entry point in its own
      project's `pyproject.toml` (the uv workspace member that owns the command,
      not the workspace-root manifest), so it installs as a real command. false
      when the CLI is only runnable via `python -m` with no console entry point
      declared, or the entry point is declared on a manifest that does not ship
      the command's code.
    files:
      include: ["**/pyproject.toml"]
